default.description: Stage 3b test profile — 90-day validity, same as Pebble's stock default.

shortlived.description: Stage 3b test profile — also 90-day validity here, deliberately identical to "default". Pebble picks a profile at random per order when the client doesn't request one explicitly (verified live: a certway newOrder with no `profile` field landed on "shortlived" as often as "default", nowhere documented in docs/ref/pebble-v2.10.1.md). Scenario 8 needs a certificate that is reliably NOT within the 30-day renewal window regardless of which profile Pebble happens to pick, so both profiles carry the same long validity here.
